name: sol_basics_vi_ovi_17
description: Uninitialized UUPS implementation contract exploitable for takeover or self-destruct
question: The source file in `source` defines a contract that inherits OpenZeppelin's UUPSUpgradeable (implementing the UUPS upgradeable proxy pattern with an initialize() function) but does not call _disableInitializers() in its constructor, leaving the implementation contract's initializer unlocked so an attacker can call initialize() directly on the implementation to become its owner, upgrade it to a malicious contract, or trigger a delegatecall-based self-destruct.
criteria: A contract extends UUPSUpgradeable and exposes an initialize() function but declares no constructor at all
A contract extends UUPSUpgradeable with a constructor that performs other setup but never calls _disableInitializers()
An upgradeable contract's initialize() function sets owner/admin state and is reachable without any prior lock on the implementation instance
A base/abstract contract inheriting UUPSUpgradeable omits _disableInitializers() in every constructor defined across the inheritance chain
